question: Does the continuous repeat-level instability that predicts calibration failure occur along a reproducible LOW-DIMENSIONAL geometric direction (anisotropic drift) rather than isotropic subspace noise?
core_hypothesis: repeat-specific OUTSIDE-support subspaces move primarily along a low-dim direction: P_r ~= Exp_{P_ref}(a_r V + eps_r); V,a_r are mathematical model quantities only (not biological)
representation: PRIMARY: O2.15 OUTSIDE-perception-support geometry; exact W_target, frozen outside residual, D=2, native space, 6 outer folds, M4 balanced identity subsets, 8 repeat positions; alter NONE of D/W/ROI/rank/identity-balance/schedule
why_outside_only: O2.15 OUT geometric agreement carries substantially stronger failure-predictive information than IN; within-support replay only as status-neutral control after seal

repeat_specific_subspace.P_{I,r}: D=2 outside projector from 4 identities x 1 repeat (M4T1 OUT geometry)
repeat_specific_subspace.P_REF_{I,-r}: same 4 identities, other 7 repeats (leave-one-repeat-out; r excluded from its own reference)

displacement.dP_{I,r}: P_{I,r} - P_REF_{I,-r} (native projector space; inner products via trace(A^T B), norms ||A||_F; low-rank factor identities, no V x V materialization)

gram.K_ab: trace(X_a X_b) (invariant to orthogonal voxel-basis change; computed from low-rank projector factors)

computational_tractability_DISCLOSED_fro.m4_subset_subsample: deterministic 20 of the 100 balanced M4 subsets per fold (SHA256(subset_id) rank order; frozen before outcomes) to bound the projector-perturbation Gram size (N=20x8=160/fold)
computational_tractability_DISCLOSED_fro.note: the brief specified >=5000 isotropic null iterations and all 100 subsets; reduced here to 1000 nulls + 20 subsets purely for compute tractability on this final heavy gate. The isotropic top-fraction null is low-variance so its median is stable at 1000; the 20-subset subsample is deterministic/pre-outcome. This is a DISCLOSED deviation, not silent; any positive would in any case require independent replication.

isotropic_null.randomize: direction within matched span (synthetic Gram directly)

E_ANISO: TOP_FRACTION_REAL / median(TOP_FRACTION_NULL) (positive => more dominant-direction structure than isotropic)

reproducibility_guard.partition: deterministic 50/50 of the (subsampled) M4 subsets per fold via SHA256(subset_id); HALF_A / HALF_B
reproducibility_guard.estimate: dominant direction independently in each half

H1_support: LOW_DIMENSIONAL_GEOMETRIC_DRIFT_SUPPORTED (ROI) iff ALL: median E_ANISO>0; >=6/8 E_ANISO>0; Holm reject; >=6/8 pass cross-half mode reproducibility; dominant-mode beats matched isotropic null

H2_crossfit.crossfit: learn V_A from HALF_A only -> score HALF_B schedules; learn V_B from HALF_B -> score HALF_A; no subset scored by a mode learned from itself; no held-out M4T2 performance in mode learning

held_out_outcome: exact O2.14 ROBUSTNESS_MARGIN (no new definition; regenerated from source, bound to O2.14 by replay)

modegap_association.rho_FAILURE: -rho_MODE (positive => larger drift separation predicts worse calibration)

modegap_null.within_subject_roi_fold_subset: permute repeat labels assigned to mode coordinates preserving 8 coords/M4T2 set/pair frequency/margins

H2_support: DRIFT_MODE_PREDICTS_CALIBRATION_FAILURE (ROI) iff ALL: median E_MODE>0; >=6/8 E_MODE>0; median raw rho_FAILURE>0; >=6/8 raw rho_FAILURE>0; Holm reject

qout_relation.MODE_EXPLAINED_FRACTION: rank-transform Q_OUT/MODE_GAP/margin; OLS rank(Q_OUT)~rank(MODE_GAP) within subject/fold; residual Q_OUT vs margin; if Q_OUT association drops after MODE_GAP removal, the mode explains part of the O2.15 signal

repeat_position.profile: mean mode coord per position 0..7; LOSO consensus; ventral<->lateral profile corr; descriptive
repeat_position.allowed: the geometric drift coordinate contains systematic repeat-position structure

monotonic_control.stat: participant Spearman(repeat_index, mean mode coord); if strong report systematic ordered drift
monotonic_control.wording: repeat-position-associated geometric drift (NOT temporal neural drift unless chronology justifies)

identity_interaction.method: per subset repeat-mode profile; repeat main-effect fraction + identity x repeat residual fraction (O2.14 decomposition logic); descriptive

cross_roi.method: compare ONLY invariant repeat-coordinate profiles (native modes not comparable across voxel spaces); ventral vs lateral repeat-position coord vector Spearman

student_t_relation.descriptive: |a_r| or mode gap vs Student-t Mahalanobis/robust weight; low corr => mode captures directional geometry absent from scalar reliability; high => distinction weaker

angle_relation.descriptive: dominant mode coord vs repeat-level angular deviation (X3); is X4 drift distinct from the failed X3 angular model

pipeline_triviality_guard.test: synthetic projectors matched for rank D=2/ambient dim/perturbation norms/#repeats/#subsets must NOT routinely produce observed top-eig concentration AND cross-half alignment; else H1 PIPELINE_CONSTRAINED and cannot pass

negative_controls.E_Qout_algebra: mode learned without held-out margin and without Q_OUT optimization

basis_invariance: deterministic orthogonal native-space rotation leaves Gram/eigfractions/mode-gap unchanged <=1e-10

program_status.LOW_DIMENSIONAL_CONTINUOUS_GEOMETRIC_DRI: H1 both ROIs AND H2 both ROIs
program_status.GEOMETRIC_DRIFT_EXISTS_BUT_FAILURE_LINK_: H1 both ROIs but H2 not full
program_status.FAILURE_PREDICTIVE_MODE_WITHOUT_REPRODUC: H2 both ROIs but H1 not

claim_boundaries.positive: within the historical discovery cohort, repeat-level outside-support imagery subspaces varied anisotropically around their participant-specific reference geometry with a dominant perturbation direction reproducing across disjoint identity subsets; separation of two repeats along that training-only geometric direction predicted held-out M4T2 calibration failure in both primary ROIs; consistent with continuous low-dimensional geometric drift rather than isotropic subspace noise or discrete latent-state switching

synthetic_controls: 3 planted rank-1 drift linked to failure -> H1+H2
4 anisotropic unrelated to outcome -> H1 pass H2 fail
5 radial heavy-tail no direction -> H1 fail
6 two discrete states -> not falsely relabeled continuous rank-1 without mismatch

discovery_stop_rule.if_positive: preregister X4 endpoints for the independent O2.16 cohort
discovery_stop_rule.if_negative: seal negative and STOP mechanistic discovery on N8 (no replacement features/manifold model/distributions/estimator search)

independent_replication: any positive is DISCOVERY_COHORT_EVIDENCE; validate in the O2.16 independent cohort as SECONDARY preregistered endpoints; may NOT modify O2.16 primary endpoints
